tokens.name: bgCard
tokens.usage: Recommended · Card background (Natural/000). Code today: Color.appBackground.

tokens.name: bgInverse
tokens.usage: Recommended · Dark surfaces: day-card header, dark tag (Natural/900). Added so dark fills have their own role; same value as textPrimary.

tokens.name: textPrimary
tokens.usage: Recommended · Primary text and icons (Natural/900). 12.64:1 on bgCard, 11.67:1 on bgScreen, 10.36:1 on fillPressed. Code today: Color.appTextDark.

tokens.name: textSecondary
tokens.usage: Recommended · Secondary text — meta, counters, secondary headers. Same charcoal as textPrimary for now (decision 2026-10-22); hierarchy comes from family, weight, size, position and spacing, not a lighter grey. Don't go thinner than Regular or smaller than 12pt to weaken it. Separate role so it can change later.

tokens.name: textOnDark
tokens.usage: Recommended · Text on bgInverse (11.67:1) and on the dark photo scrim: LIVE tag, day-card titles, Live card. Code today: Color.appSurface.

tokens.name: textDisabled
tokens.usage: Recommended · Label of a disabled control (Natural/800 on fillDisabled, 2.67:1; disabled controls are exempt from the minimum). Never for active text.

tokens.name: decorative
tokens.usage: Recommended · Decorative marks and large display only (≥ 18pt bold / 24pt). Not for small text: 3.26:1 on bgCard, 3.01:1 on bgScreen.

tokens.name: borderHairline
tokens.usage: Recommended · Separators and card hairlines (Natural/200); decorative, no contrast minimum. Code today: Color.appHairline.

tokens.name: borderControl
tokens.usage: Recommended · Edges that identify a control, such as inputs (Natural/800): 3.26:1 on bgCard, 3.01:1 on bgScreen. Not on fillPressed (2.67:1).

tokens.name: fillPressed
tokens.usage: Recommended · Pressed / selected fill on white cards (Natural/200). A separate role from fillDisabled even with the same value. Code today: Color.appCardPressed.

tokens.name: fillDisabled
tokens.usage: Recommended · Fill of a disabled control, replacing the yellow (Natural/200). A separate role from fillPressed. Code today: Color.appAccentDisabled.

tokens.name: appAccent

shadow.note: Values are CSS for the simulation. SwiftUI mapping (one .shadow per layer, radius ≈ half the CSS blur) is an estimate — verify in the Simulator.

tokens.name: shadow.resting
tokens.usage: Recommended (provisional) · [Proposal, chosen 2026-10-22] Depth 1 · Resting — default for content cards, including the Café / Live card. Charcoal (Natural/900) tint. Re-check once the real photos are in. SwiftUI estimate: .shadow(color: charcoal.opacity(0.06), radius: 1, y: 1).shadow(color: charcoal.opacity(0.06), radius: 4, y: 2), after .clipShape.

meta.statusTags: [Brand] brand foundation · [Home] approved Home · [App] existing code value · [Proposal] not yet decided
meta.usageTiers: Recommended = use for new work · Legacy (compatibility) = kept for existing code and future review · Alias = no own value · Reference only = brand scale for comparison · Option = defined for a specific case, not applied yet
meta.colorNaming: Colors view: no prefix = Recommended (semantic roles + accent + levels); brand-… = brand palette for reference; code-… = mapping of today's Swift names to the roles; legacy-… = legacy and alias tokens kept for compatibility (Swift name after the prefix).
